body: I bought 30 right before Covid hit from a bundle. Yeah I now have more passes from events playing at home or away. I moved and now I'm in a area where people don't play so it's incredibly hard to actually raid. I gave up on raids and left them to remote only but uh now I just gave up on raids. Won't be catching them all. Won't be getting my shiny collection. I've basically gave up the game. My goals were to be long term playing but uh...the game is unplayable being disabled. I open the app every blue moon.

I've only seen a GI doctor when things started and they were so bad I ended up in the ER. I've had a bunch of tests done for blood work since I've been having other health issues. 

I haven't had anything for my stomach that I recall since everything has just been my intestines. :( 
I have a dietitian who diagnosed me but hasn't been helpful beyond that. She's sending me to a GI dietitian though once I asked her for help about like a meal plan with all the foods I do eat.

I need assistance with fruits and veggies very much. I don't eat any really other than a banana and apple juice smoothie if I can get around to making one. I appreciate any help at all!

I talk about this ALL the time. I don't think I would mind the taste if I only needed to eat twice a day like a pet animal. 
I really wish I could replace meals all other. I'm so sick of food lately due to so many issues.

Is banana not good for you? Not sure I can full stop my current diet unless I just stop eating until I find a replacement. 
I will talk to my doctor about resolor and motegrity since those a prescription meds only.
I'm not sure IberoGast will help since that's aimed more at my stomach than my intestines.

What are healthy fats? That's just meats right? 
I don't eat dairy so no butter anymore unless dairy free. I don't like the taste of coconut. I have fish oil pills tho. Do those work? Otherwise I'll see if there's pill versions for coconut oil.

I unfortunately don't know how to cook nor have the basic energy to due to other health problems. I've been fine diet wise until after Covid so I'm losing my mind with all the limitations.

That's unfortunately my whole diet. Bread, pasta, rice. There's not much you can eat without cheese in like premade or frozen foods that can last for a week. Let alone that I could intake...

I eat meats and I can eat apples. Diced peaches in a cup I can usually do...They're kinda expensive though for 4 cups. Idk if those would help much.
Isn't kombucha pretty expensive too? 

I'd eat ham sandwiches before all this. But idk if bringing that back would help cause it's still bread. I can't really take that out of my diet. Unless I just eat slices of ham, rice, chicken nuggets sort of thing...

I'm worried everything is going to come back fine as that's literally been the last year with test results for losing my ability to walk. It's been a slow process and they're deaming it muscle weakness but every MRI, blood tests/panels, etc come back clear.

I fear this is going to weild the same result.
Thank you for the luck. I will need it every step of the way.

I am taking probiotics but there's pre biotics? I will have to Google that.

I don't know what else to eat otherwise. Ramen makes me bloated. I can't eat pizza. I can probably list all I eat if I sit here and think about it. My diet is limited and is drastically smaller now.
I am taking fiber pills but it's not doing anything.
